summary.zh-CN: 理解业务需求，澄清歧义，并将其拆解为可验收的任务。
summary.en: Understand the business need, resolve its ambiguities and break it into tasks that can be accepted.

summary.zh-CN: 在既有约束下提出技术方案，权衡取舍并形成设计决策。
summary.en: Propose a technical approach within the existing constraints, weigh the trade-offs and reach design decisions.

summary.zh-CN: 在既有代码库中实现功能、修复缺陷，并与现有代码保持一致。
summary.en: Implement features and fix defects in an existing codebase, consistent with the code around them.

summary.zh-CN: 审查代码变更，识别缺陷与风险，并提出可执行的修改意见。
summary.en: Review code changes, identify defects and risks, and give feedback that can be acted on.

summary.zh-CN: 设计并执行测试，定位失败原因，判断变更能否交付。
summary.en: Design and run tests, locate the causes of failures and judge whether a change can be delivered.

summary.zh-CN: 完成构建与发布，管理变更，并在异常时安全回滚。
summary.en: Build and release, manage changes, and roll back safely when something goes wrong.

summary.zh-CN: 响应告警，诊断线上故障，恢复服务并说明根因。
summary.en: Respond to alerts, diagnose production failures, restore service and explain the root cause.

summary.zh-CN: 重构代码、迁移系统与升级依赖，保证系统的长期可维护性。
summary.en: Refactor code, migrate systems and upgrade dependencies so that the system stays maintainable.
